read: The rooftop glows orange, drinks in hand, crowd chatty; they need a slow, warm build to shift into movement.

tracks.title: Kerala
tracks.why: Lush, melodic groove eases crowd into sunset vibe.
tracks.transition: Slow fade, introduce subtle percussive loop to lift energy.

tracks.title: Glowed Up
tracks.why: Smooth R&B rhythm adds body while keeping relaxed atmosphere.
tracks.transition: Raise high‑pass filter, bring in brighter synths for momentum.

tracks.title: Atlas
tracks.why: Progressive chords amplify tension, inviting subtle movement.
tracks.transition: Layer four‑on‑four kick, increase volume for dancefloor shift.

tracks.title: Dopamine
tracks.why: Funky disco groove ignites smile, nudges feet onto floor.
tracks.transition: Drop bass filter, transition to vocal‑driven house energy.

tracks.title: Cola
tracks.why: Catchy vocal hook drives house groove, peak energy builds.
tracks.transition: Switch to darker synth, boost tempo, prepare climax.

tracks.title: Losing It
tracks.why: Massive bassline and rhythm unleash full dancefloor release.
tracks.transition: Fade out gradually, let crowd ride peak energy to next set.
